column1: # A quoted word and the word with a note after it are not the token: each goes to the codec,
# which refuses it, so the row reads its effective default and draws InvalidValue.

column4: Line 2: [General] EnableOnStartup="default" is not valid (expected true or false), so the default is used.
Line 4: [Smoothing] LocalSmoothing=default ; note is not valid (expected a number from 0.0 to 1.0), so the default is used.
